key_insight: SymPlex discovers analytical, human-readable symbolic solutions to PDEs without ground-truth expressions by framing symbolic formula generation as a tree-structured decision process and optimizing candidates directly with PDE residuals and boundary conditions.
problem_solved: Automatically finding closed-form symbolic solutions to partial differential equations is hard because search spaces are combinatorial, syntax must be respected, and no paired symbolic ground-truth is available; SymPlex addresses these challenges by combining reinforcement learning with a structure-aware Transformer to produce valid, physics-consistent expressions.
method: Formulate symbolic PDE solving as tree-structured decision-making and apply reinforcement learning where rewards come from PDE residuals and boundary-condition satisfaction (no ground-truth expressions needed).
Introduce SymFormer, a structure-aware Transformer that uses tree-relative self-attention to model hierarchical dependencies and enforces syntactic/grammar constraints during expression generation.
Iteratively generate, evaluate and refine candidate symbolic trees using physics-based rewards to discover analytical solutions that satisfy the PDE and boundary conditions.
impact: Provides a practical route to automatically discover interpretable analytic PDE solutions, enabling better scientific insight, symbolic generalization, and reduced reliance on labeled symbolic data—useful for scientific ML, physics-informed modeling, and symbolic reasoning research.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: RL loop showing expression tree generation → PDE residual & boundary-condition evaluation → reward → policy update.
Illustration of a symbolic expression tree with tree-relative attention arcs highlighting hierarchical dependencies captured by SymFormer.
Before/after comparison chart: numeric PDE solution vs discovered symbolic closed-form showing error, compactness, and interpretability.
Icon set: PDE equation, tree (syntax), transformer block (attention), and a reward gauge to convey optimization without ground-truth.
paper_title: SymPlex: A Structure-Aware Transformer for Symbolic PDE Solving
paper_authors: Yesom Park, Annie C. Lu, Shao-Ching Huang, Qiyang Hu, Y. Sungtaek Ju
